verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh lets cases, alerts and risks be reviewed and remediated through the API as well as the web app. Cases can be filtered by risk, stage, assignee and creation date, and they carry defined decisions, so an agent with scoped API credentials can pull the flagged queue and its screening context. The docs describe no agent-oriented layer, however: no AI evidence summarization, no recommendation or proposed-decision state awaiting human confirmation, and no MCP or agent integration. Summarizing and recommending would rest entirely on the user's own agent. missing for 10: native evidence summarization, recommend-then-human-confirm workflow (draft decisions), agent/MCP integration, hands-on corroboration of agent queue work.
